items.title: Assurant (AIZ) Stock Trades Near Fair Value After A 94% Run
items.summary: Assurant has delivered a strong run over the last few years, and the stock’s sharp climb now puts the focus squarely on whether its earnings can support today’s share price. With Assurant trading around US$271.08 at the last close, the question is how comfortably that level lines up with what the business is actually earning.
